projects.name: Klang.ai
projects.description: A voice analytics tool kit for English, which can perform sentiment analysis, NER, emotion detection from audio ﬁles and live audio using DeepSpeech Model trained on common voice dataset and DistillBert model using python TensorFlow, pyaudio.

projects.name: Brain Tumor Segmentation
projects.description: Using the BRATS 2013 dataset to build a brain tumor segmentation model, we created 2D slices from the MRI scan and designed a 2 path CNN model for Segmentation using TensorFlow.

projects.name: Speech Emotion Classiﬁcation
projects.description: Extracted MFCC values from audio samples and used Convolutional Neural Networks to detect the emotional sentiment of the audio from the MELD dataset.
